deliverables: DeFi Kernel registry website and submission process
public documentation, reporting, and integration support
request.recipient: Dano Finance, with Minswap Labs serving as budget administrator
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Dano Finance's DeFi Kernel registry, Spot Leverage Order Book, American Options Market-Making protocol, and Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,333,000 ADA total, consisting of 3,300,000 ADA for delivery and 33,000 ADA as a 1% budget administration fee for Minswap Labs.
Dano Finance says the DeFi Kernel will provide an open, fee-free, royalty-free compatibility standard and registry for Cardano DeFi contracts.
The proposal claims Cardano DeFi is fragmented across liquidity, metadata, and execution paths, which slows integrations and limits advanced financial applications.
Dano Finance claims it currently has approximately USD 18M in TVL and more than 10,000 on-chain transactions.

The work is divided into four budgeted work packages: 300,000 ADA for the registry, 1,000,000 ADA for the Spot Leverage Order Book, 1,000,000 ADA for the American Options Protocol, and 1,000,000 ADA for the SDK.
The proposal says smart contract workstreams will include security review or audit before mainnet release and that unresolved critical security issues block affected mainnet milestones.

The proposal sets KPIs of USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day trading volume for the Spot Leverage Order Book and USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day option notional volume within 90 days of mainnet launch, measured using public on-chain data.
Dano Finance says unused or unearned funds will remain unspent or be returned to the Cardano Treasury according to the administrator's process.

Dano Finance says it will return 5% of protocol fees from the Treasury-funded Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options contracts for 12 months after mainnet launch, after direct costs and reported publicly.
The proposal references dano.finance, defikernel.org, and a DeFi Kernel GitHub registry as external resources related to the work.

summary: The document presents a large 3,333,000 ADA DeFi infrastructure and protocol build request with named deliverables, milestones, KPIs, administrator role, and repayment/fee-return commitments, but many impact, feasibility, and financial assertions remain proposer-stated rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
